| Severity | Location | Lens | Summary |

| Major | `atlas_reviewer/rounds.py:150-184` | tracing-correctness-and-invariants | Prior-round omissions are monotonic. Three things each block approval: going over the budget, a `findings_omitted` record at any head, and a superseded record dropped from the window. Because the log is append-only, every one of them stays forever. Probe: 80 clean records give `30 earlier round(s) not shown`, so the PR can never approve again. |
